task.ask: a burr coffee grinder for home espresso and pour-over

products.name: Burr Coffee Grinder
products.title: Burr Coffee Grinder
products.description: The KitchenAid® Burr Coffee Grinder is a professional-quality kitchen appliance designed to deliver a consistent grind for various brewing methods. It features a clear bean hopper, a digital display for precise control, and Automatic Smart Dosing Technology that adjusts the grind amount based on the desired number of cups or shots. With steel burrs and a wide range of grind settings, it is suitable for everything from coarse cold brew and French press to fine espresso, and includes a built-in adjustable portafilter holder for 54mm or 58mm portafilters.
